title: featurePlanAction
responsibility: Select a page design or explicitly approve and dispatch the exact ready feature plan under the selected project repository lease.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.context
inputs.description: Trusted selected project session; caller holds the repository write lease.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.input
inputs.description: Explicit project and feature identity plus exact current plan digest; selection includes one page and option, approval includes a named reviewer.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.writable
inputs.description: Trusted live-client and writable-source revision check, repeated around asynchronous work.

inputs.name: featurePlanAction.sampleResources
inputs.description: Optional host memory and pressure sample; missing or unavailable data limits approval dispatch to one worker.

outputs.name: featurePlanAction.select
outputs.description: Validates project identity, current plan digest and source revision, then commits the selected page option as a new unapproved plan revision.

outputs.name: featurePlanAction.approve
outputs.description: Rechecks project and source, readiness-validates and commits the named approval, then invokes ModuleTaskServerService.runApproved with the exact plan digest and memory-bounded parallelism. Returns actual admitted task IDs, run results and selected parallelism.

errors.name: stale or foreign context
errors.description: Rejects missing or foreign project, stale digest, changed source or ended client before mutating or dispatching.

errors.name: readiness, queue or worker failure
errors.description: Propagates plan readiness and task admission failures. A committed approval may remain after a later dispatch failure and can be retried with the same plan digest.

errors.name: resource probe failure
errors.description: Keeps approval eligible and limits worker concurrency to one when resource information is missing, unavailable or pressured.
